intro: Between 14 April and 12 May 2026, five critical articles were published under the SAP tag, covering vulnerabilities and threat activity. The threat actors mini Shai-Hulud and Mini Shai-Hulud were observed. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-27681 with a CVSS score of 9.9, as well as CVE-2026-34259, CVE-2026-34260, and CVE-2026-34263, each with a CVSS score of 9.6. The affected sectors were enterprise software, cloud services, financial services, manufacturing, and retail.
